requirements.obligation: Use one shared workload model across architecture, testing and cost calculations
Treat the workload as a proposed planning model, not measured capacity
Record observed student behavior and revise the model before claiming capacity
Use 10800 seconds as the nominal planning exam duration
Keep actual exam duration configuration-driven
Model 500000 commitments per30seconds as 16666.7 requests/second
Keep explicit commitments in the critical durable lane
Model20percent dirty drafts per10seconds as10000 requests/second
Classify drafts as recoverable writes, not grading commitments
Model independent leases for500000 sessions per60seconds as8333.3 requests/second
Reserve the critical control lane for lease work
Model35000 live requests/second before coalescing
Model500000 telemetry batches per30seconds as16666.7 batches/second
Isolate telemetry in a separate bounded lane
Model51666.7 normal combined requests/second
Account for CDN asset hits separately from baseline API traffic
Model all-dirty drafts every5seconds plus commits and leases as the125000-live-request pathological scenario
Qualify two-times normal live throughput of70000 requests/second
Qualify two-times telemetry throughput of33333.3 batches/second
Do not infer pathological workload success from two-times normal headroom
Test the pathological workload separately
Coalesce recoverable work while preserving eligible commitments
Keep API requests, transactions, response rows, events and storage IOPS as distinct units
Model500000 starts over120seconds as4166.7 starts/second
Model500000 submissions over30seconds as16666.7 submissions/second
Model2MB packages across500000students as1TB edge delivery and66.667Gbit/s over120seconds before overhead
State decimal byte and bandwidth units in capacity evidence
State cache assumptions in capacity evidence
Disclose whether package assets are prefetched in the measured run
Measure per-cell write amplification and index overhead rather than equating API RPS with DB TPS
Treat20cells of25000activeattempts as a proposed partition, not measured capacity
Qualify500000 concurrently active sessions for a full three-hour exam workload
Use distinct authenticated attempts exercising reading, changes, commits, leases and submit, not idle or registered users
Require measured evidence and operator signoff for proposed acceptance targets
Use20proposed cells with at most25000admitted active attempts per qualified cell
Freeze resource specification, database variant, pools, versions, route distribution and exam mix in the run manifest
Qualify twice each cell baseline mix as proposed headroom
Test the declared bursts and failure scenarios separately
Never describe spare capacity, autoscaling limits or small-test success as guaranteed500000capacity
Name the exact database deployment variant in evidence
Do not assign an unverified shared replication promise to distinct database deployment variants
Protect admitted sessions while reducing new admissions
Identify which covered failures preserve acknowledged writes in capacity approval
Disclose regional disasters that can lose asynchronously replicated data
Display Saved only for a durable committed response, never draft/cache/queue acceptance alone
Measure valid commit in-region ingress-to-durable-ack p95 at most300ms
Measure valid commit ingress-to-durable-ack p99 at most1000ms including queueing and persistence
Separately measure client round-trip and rendered save feedback on representative Indian networks
Do not relabel server processing time as total student latency
Obtain operator approval of a separate client-experience budget before launch
Require durable submission receipt p99 at most2seconds under the declared submission burst
Require receipt-to-correct-core-grade readiness p95 at most60seconds
Require receipt-to-correct-core-grade readiness p99 at most120seconds; a visible pending grade is allowed meanwhile
Require server errors at most0.1percent across the full run
Require server errors at most0.1percent inside every predeclared critical window
Allow zero wrong grades within the covered failure envelope
Allow zero duplicate score effects within the covered failure envelope
Allow zero lost acknowledged commits within the covered failure envelope
Distinguish correctness, API performance, browser behavior, connection capacity and disaster recovery evidence
Publish achieved load and shortfalls
Never pass an interrupted, under-generated or reduced-activity run
Use identical endpoint and timing definitions in generators, dashboards and release decisions
Version the workload, SLO definitions and failure envelope
Require both qualified-cell and global-run approval decisions
Preserve admitted-session write capacity during admission throttling
